defect_observations.observation: The collinearity sentence (individual coefficient rankings can fail to be uniquely defined when the fitted response is unique) carries the citation SaltelliAnnoni2010Sensitivity Section 5.2. Held source Sec. 5.2 (p. 1511) says low R^2 makes standardized-coefficient rankings pointless and that the squared coefficients sum to R^2 for independent factors; it does not discuss collinearity or non-unique coefficients. The citation placement attributes a handbook claim to the source. Does not remove coverage of ED26-GAP-SCI-005-C02.

States that the article gives computational recipes for independent inputs only. Held source Sec. 5.4 (p. 1512) gives no recipe; it points to Saltelli (2002) and Saltelli et al. (2010) for independent inputs and to Saltelli and Tarantola (2002) and Da Veiga et al. (2009) for dependent inputs.

The step giving S_Ti = 0 exactly when Y is almost surely a function of X_{-i} rests on 'the measurable-factorization result for real coordinate tuples', which is neither labelled nor proved anywhere on the handbook route (search for Doob-Dynkin / measurable factorization found none). This is ancillary to ED26-GAP-SCI-005-C03; the index derivations themselves are written.

The brackets 0.0771 < c_*(0.05) < 0.0772 and 0.1632 < c_*(0.1) < 0.1633 and the radii 0.0638, 0.0927, 0.0785 are asserted as evaluations of m_1 with no displayed values and no annex certificate (contrast the bracketing evaluations written for thm:p15-w02b-p15-070-linearized-margin at annex lines 332-360). The table prints the radii without the approximation qualifier used in the text. The table's verdicts have margins far wider than the stated bracket widths, so no sign is decided inside the stated error.

Says the source reports 21 versus 24 evaluations at d=5 and 29 versus 32 at d=7. The held source text (Sec. 6.1, pp. 1512-1513, Figs. 4-5) states the rule 1+4k and round((1+4k)/(k+1)) trajectories and the d=2 total of nine; the d=5 and d=7 counts were not found as reported values in the extractable source text. They follow from the stated rule.

The worked sensitivity families use stipulated ranges and parameters chosen for exactness: ranges [-1,1] and [-3,3] (global-sensitivity-and-robustness.tex 521-525), coupling rho and curvature gamma (069 lines 79-88 and 234-242), and contamination levels 0.05 and 0.10 (070 lines 286-300). The 'justified ranges' wording of ED26-GAP-SCI-005-C04 is carried procedurally (global 542-544; 069 274-278; 070 40-41) and by reporting status sets, breaking values and radii over the whole parameter range, not by a substantively justified range. Recorded here; it does not remove coverage.
